notes.title: Somber Echoes content update and news
notes.content:
July 8th, marks the release of Somber Echoes on Playstation and Xbox, but also a significant milestone in our post-release efforts. We would like to seize the opportunity to thank every single one of our players for your constructive feedback and encouraging words. 



Paying close attention to your feedback, we focused our efforts on addressing the most reported concerns in the update that was released on June 27th, and the one update that we are releasing today. We are also introducing some extra content that we hope will satisfy those among you that enjoy an extra challenge.



As a reminder, the highlights of our previous patch are:

District outlines, traveling between all rest shrines and an item locator feature to make finding your way around the Atromitos even easier.

Improvements to lantern traversal and the Supernova ability that make exploration smoother and even more enjoyable.


With our Playstation and Xbox release, all versions of Somber Echoes are receiving the following additional content in the form of challenges:

Speedrun modes

Make your way to and defeat the Phoenix boss

Start from scratch and get to the final boss

With a full loadout and every door unlocked from the start, hunt down and defeat all bosses



Boss challenges

Varying difficulty boss fights with a predetermined loadouts



Supernova puzzles

7 traversal puzzles that will challenge you problem solving skills as well as your mastery of the Supernova mechanic


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeIEZinkCJ4yQQQLQZ3HePpkGvNmA1GUPw9uFWgtgM9OCt55O1DLpVsxFS6nYS5K0wmBImYLkMsiEm3J_zvPn2IngGW0joqzmLaa65PXehUEjXOOo-KvwmvitlGwNQw-tuwGBpMhA?key=ffz4x7ugyh_ZRHYGPjkyfg"]

Each of the challenges have varying unlocking conditions that vary from reaching a specific point in the game, or defeating a certain boss, to finishing the whole game once.


Journal
Our initial intention with the presentation of the narrative in Somber Echoes was to keep it somewhat discreet and elusive, requiring players that cared for it to pay some attention to figure out what had happened. At the same time it would be out of the way for more action oriented players.



Reacting to your feedback about the story being too elusive, we are adding a brand new inventory tab called Journal. It keeps track of all important storylines and also provides context in the form of Adrestia’s insights into the evolving narrative. 


[img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdsmJ8wLHTFfJVtZq7UmrGUoJ2l6RzrygHoc2fAVIBIXO8igZSgE2JZkirOJnwEXRBij0ubgufppBYiHwip6pVxLbgTL8-cO386SukoOcolSDcBu11qtVXZCHqV8sueOSUPeSUkLw?key=ffz4x7ugyh_ZRHYGPjkyfg"]

Journal nodes are filled in as you progress through the game and discover narrative moments. Each node may have various story tidbits associated with it, which will be linked together, to give you the complete picture of what has happened, and what Adrestia’s reaction to the unfolding events is. The journal can be opened at any time to serve as an overview of where the story has taken you so far, or to jog your memory about a specific narrative point.



We hope you will enjoy the new challenges and that the fixes and additions of the latest two patches address your most prominent feedback. We remain devoted to acting on your continued feedback to make Somber Echoes the best it can be.



Thank you!

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Update #7 - June 2025
notes.content:
Map system updates:
Powering up any of the Circe Chambers will reveal the outline of the entire district that the chamber is associated with.

Added two new Circe Chambers one for the Cesspit and one for the Higher Residence district.

An item locator feature has been added to the Circe Chambers functionality:

To activate the feature you need to power up the Circe Chamber close to the end of the game.

Once activated, the Item Locator will be available to all Circe Chambers.

Each Circe Chamber reveals the location of Upgrade materials, Survivors, Nyx Fragments and Necklace Pieces within the district it belongs to.

Locating an item through this feature incurs a fixed Favor cost per item.
Fast Travel updates:
Adrestia can now fast travel between any discovered shrines with the following condition:

To fast travel to and from any shrine, you must have activated the Circe Chamber for both the origin and destination districts.
Lantern traversal updates:
The collision when exiting an Aether Lantern has been improved:

This will result in less unwanted collisions with level corners and ledges when using the lantern to traverse the levels.

The “grace period” and conditions for exiting the Supernova state has been made more generous:

When you hit a surface head on while in the Supernova State, Adrestia will remain in the state for longer, allowing you a longer time to react.

When you hit a surface at a very shallow angle while in the Supernova State, the vector of your trajectory will be made parallel to the surface, allowing for nailing puzzles that stretch for long distances more easily.

In general these changes should make our more challenging puzzles a bit more manageable and less frustrating.
System:
Added an option to adjust the timing of damage received 

This change is mainly aimed at TV or other slower refresh rate/higher latency monitor players.

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #6
notes.content:
Map fixes

 Fixes to map navigation.

Enemy spawn and pathfinding

 Fixed some issues related to Hatchling(spider enemy) pathfinding.
 Fixed an issue where Hatchlings could sometimes spawn in places they shouldnt.

Overall performance improvements.

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #5
notes.content:
QoL map updates:

 Added an icon indicating where you last died.
 Shuttles and portals will now show their destination.
 Overall map fixes.
 Quest markers are added in a clearer way.

Controller updates:

 Added controller vibration, intensity can be changed in Options - Controls.
 It is now easier to aim straight using the D-Pad on a controller.

Misc:

 Various bug fixes.
 Fixes to menus
 Fixes to various enemies and bosses.
 Improvement to overall stability

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #4 - Early game adjustments
notes.content:
Balance changes to help ease players into the early parts of The Lower Residence, as well as removing some frustration throughout.


 Added more Nyx crystals to help with health recovery in the early parts of Lower Residence.
 Removed a few projectile based enemies in one of the early levels.
 Moved the rest shrine in Plundered Market, to make it easier to spot.
 Changed Nocturnal Pools to no longer do damage to the player. They will still move you to the previous “safe spot”.

notes.title: Somber Echoes - Patch #3
notes.content:
Bug fixes - Bosses and weapons

 Fixed an issue with attacks lingering on Stymphalian Statue
 Fixed an issue where the Arbiter weapon would in specific cases, do much more damage than intended.

Map updates(Icons/Readability)

 Added icons for survivors
 Updated the “quest” map icon to make it more visible
 Fixed some instances of “quest” icons not being properly removed
 Improved the color coding and contrast for the whole map
 When a “quest” is unlocked, the map will focus on the exact location of it

Level transition stability

 Fixed some edge cases where issues could arise from performing certain actions when transitioning 
between levels

Preparation for cloud save

 In between step to prepare the game for cloud save activation

Game save state

 Rescuing survivors will now save their state immediately
 Unlocking a statue memory will now save its state immediately
 Fixed some secret areas not saving their state after being hidden

Misc:

 Tweaks and polish applied to various cutscenes and animations
 Updated icons for button press prompts in tutorials and hints
 Added a tutorial for Aether Strips.

notes.title: Second Big Patch live now!
notes.content:
Fast Travel update:  


 Fast travel between Rest Shrines and C.I.R.C.E Chambers in the same district are now linked.
 Added a rest shrine near [spoiler] The Grove Shuttle area.[/spoiler]

 Progression improvements 


 Fixed some map elements and breakable walls linked to secrets, to help progressing the critical path.
 To ensure checkpoints are updated, we added an automatic save when walking past rest shrines. 
 Added an additional rest shrine in Lower Residence, to smooth out the early section.
 Added map icon for [spoiler] Hephaestus’s Workshop. [/spoiler]

 Supernova grace period 


 Added a slight grace period when hitting walls. This will help entering Aether Lanterns that are very close to walls.

Some enemy hitboxes were adjusted.
Various bug fixes.

notes.title: First Big Patch live now!
notes.content:
Update to base hover skill. Before, Hover and Hover boost had different ways of activating, but they are now unified. It now activates by holding the jump button while jumping/zapping, instead of having to release and press again (in the case of base hover).
- Also does not deactivate by doing a downwards move input.
 Fixed an issue where you could get stuck inside Radiant surfaces while using supernova and lightstream.
 Fixed an issue where a certain statue was not saved as found.
[spoiler] - If this happened to you, it should be fixed by going back to The Maiden statue to retrigger the cutscene. [/spoiler]
 Solved an issue where the map would sometimes automatically start moving when you open the map.
 Improved cutscene stability.
 Currently unsupported languages now default to English.
 Solved an issue where the aim effect on certain abilities would increase in intensity, resulting in obstructing view.
 Bug fixes on various enemies.
 Improvements for SteamDeck
 Tutorial Video support for SteamDeck.

notes.title: Breaking: Changing name to Sombrero Geckos
notes.content:
We have made the somewhat interesting decision to change the name of Somber Echoes to Sombrero Geckos to accommodate the new protagonist - a gecko sporting a sombrero.

- In self-reflection we have found Somber Echoes to be slightly on the moody side, but intense playtesting has shown that a cute lizard with a fun hat throws a much needed “sparkle” to the mix, says Lead Designer Vangelis Kalaitzis.

- It was frustrating to have all these unused jokes that wouldn’t fit in a greek tragedy. To finally be able to use them feels like an intervention from Dionysus himself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905402/f75c252d3abc9296227ae6efaeaece380828c4aa.jpg
The rewritten narrative will now see Pete “The Lizard Wizard” as the star in what will be a Greek Comedy Metroidvania, replacing the intendended Greek tragedy.

- We feel that a fun loving protagonist in a contrasting environment adds to the comedy - like the “Ace Ventura of Video games“

Besides the dashing new protagonist, most of the game will stay the same and the intentional release window for late 2024 will stay on target.

- Pete will not only make you laugh, but also move you to tears, says designer Tom-Ivar Arntzen.
